title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
description: Microsoft Purview is upgrading inline data protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business. The experience integrates with a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access grant control and simplifies configuration while removing current Purview policy restrictions. Admins can now use expanded conditions and condition combinations, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, configurable alerts and notifications, and rule match activities are visible in activity explorer.
